H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H7321: to mar (especially by breaking); figuratively, to split the ears (with sound), i.e. shout (for alarm or joy)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)

H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H3584: to be untrue, in word (to lie, feign, disown) or deed (to disappoint, fail, cringe)

H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H5949: an exploit (of God), or a performance (of man, often in a bad sense); by implication, an opportunity
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H2015: to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H5104: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H7272: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H8055: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome
H1369: force (literally or figuratively); by implication, valor, victory

H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H6822: properly, to lean forward, i.e. to peer into the distance; by implication, to observe, await
H5637: to turn away, i.e. (morally) be refractory
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing

H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H4132: a wavering, i.e. fall; by implication, a pole (as shaking); hence, a yoke (as essentially a bent pole)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed

H6884: to fuse (metal), i.e. refine (literally or figuratively)
H3701: silver (from its pale color); by implication, money
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H4686: a net, or (abstractly) capture; also a fastness
H4975: properly, the waist or small of the back; only in plural the loins

H582: a man in general (singly or collectively)
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H5930: a step or (collectively, stairs, as ascending); usually a holocaust (as going up in smoke)
H7999: to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications)
H5088: a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.

H8193: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)

H5973: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)

H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H1241: beef cattle or an animal of the ox family of either gender (as used for plowing); collectively, a herd
H6260: prepared, i.e. full grown; spoken only (in plural) of he-goats, or (figuratively) leaders of the people

H8478: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.

H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H7181: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
